SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu

   B. Treat Population Structure as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Structure.
   D. Explain Population Structure with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
